page.layout: One page of text, one column, no margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. Below the last line: a faint gathering signature at the foot, centre.

main_text.p: Martis, significant multa bella, inventionesq; operum mechanicorum propter Martem, morbosq; malignos, contagiosos, propter scorpionem & cancrum, mixtionemq; Martis cum Venere & Luna: tum graves hæreses Mahumeticas, lex enim & religio sub hoc trigono habuit initium.

13. Conjunctiones in signis igneis si fiant, tunc mundi Imperia & Monarchiæ constituuntur propter Solem & Jovem, hujus triplicitatis Dominos, qui significant tranquillitatem in mundo, hominumq; sapientiam & industriam, sed sterilitates insignes, propter dominium calidorum & Planetarum & signorum.

14. Conjunctiones in trigoni terrei signis terræ motus significant, & inundationes, nec non Cometas propter capricornum, in quo dominantur Mars & Saturnus, significant quoque dissipationem eorum, quæ parta sunt & conquisita sub trigono aqueo.

15. Conjunctiones in signis aereis dissipatione Monarchiarum, per trigonum igneum institutarum portendunt, vel traductionem Monarchiæ in aliam mundi partem, & propter dominium Saturni & Mercurii vigebunt artes, & viri sapientes pariter atq; improbissimi, vitia, libidines, apparebuntq; propter Mercurium multi Planetæ.
16. Stellæ verticales magnam habent vim, suntq; illæ, quæ tantam habent declinationem ab æquatore, quanta est elevatio poli illius regionis.
17. Stellæ, quæ simul in eadem regione ascendunt, aut medium cœli obtinent, aut descendunt, plurimum eodem possunt tempore, quia vires inter se commiscent.
18. Stellæ, quæ in communi sunt circulo positionis, multum possunt, quia singulis diebus vires suas invicem commiscent.

page.notes: The running head reads "Discursus" in small capitals. The top-left page number is printed as "n8", which I read as 118; uncertain. The signature "P 3" at the foot is faint and uncertain. The line-end "in-" before "mundo" in paragraph 13 may be a printed hyphen or an ink mark; I wrote "in mundo" as two words. Faint show-through of text from the reverse side is visible across the page and has been left out. Printed "significant" in paragraph 14 and elsewhere is written with a plain s as required.
